mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT fi.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_stockinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'stock' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fi.is_deleted = 0 AND fi.security_status = 'L' ORDER BY dst.sort_order ASC ,fi.security_type ASC

SELECT fi.* ,dst.security_type_name ,( SELECT sr.rating_code FROM rrs_stock_rating sr WHERE sr.stock_code = fi.stock_code AND sr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sr.rating_date DESC ,sr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_rating ,( SELECT sr.rating_code FROM rrs_stock_rating sr WHERE sr.stock_code = fi.stock_code AND sr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sr.rating_date DESC ,sr.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1 ) previous_rating FROM rrs_stockinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'stock' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fi.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND fi.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT ips.id ,ips.target_pool_id ,ips.target_pool_name AS poolName ,ips.pool_type ,ips.entry_time FROM ip_pool_status_stock ips WHERE ips.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ips.entry_time DESC ,ips.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT target_pool_id FROM ip_pool_status_stock WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ip_adjust_step_stock WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ip_adjust_log_stock WHERE adjust_batch_no = #{adjustBatchNo} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_adjust_log_stock SET audit_status = #{auditStatus} ,audit_time = NOW() ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE adjust_batch_no = #{adjustBatchNo} AND is_deleted = 0 AND audit_status IN ('00', '11')
UPDATE ip_pool_status_stock SET is_deleted = 1 ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT entry_time FROM ip_pool_status_stock WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT target_pool_id AS id ,COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) AS currentCount FROM ip_pool_status_stock WHERE audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY target_pool_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FROM ip_pool_status_stock WHERE target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT pool_id ,relation_type ,relation_pool_id FROM ip_pool_relation WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT industry_code ,industry_name FROM rrs_stockinfo WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND industry_code IS NOT NULL AND industry_code != '' ORDER BY industry_code ,industry_name
